name: CreditEvent
description: Specifies the relevant data regarding a credit event.

auctionDate.description: The date on which the auction is scheduled to occur.

creditEventType.description: The type of credit event taking place.

eventDeterminationDate.description: The date in which the credit event is determined by the Credit Derivatives Determinations Comitee.

finalPrice.description: The final price resulting from the auction.

publiclyAvailableInformation.description: A public information source, e.g. a particular newspaper or electronic news service, that may publish relevant information used in the determination of whether or not a credit event has occurred.

recoveryPercent.description: The percentage of the original value of the asset affected by the credit event that can be recovered.

referenceInformation.description: The reference entity, part of a credit basket, impacted by the credit event.
